Method of Attack: Deploying a DaemonSet named 'proxy-api' to engage resources of all nodes in a Kubernetes cluster simultaneously to mine Dero coin
Using a modified CentOS 7 Docker image with additional files 'entrypoint.sh' (initializes miner with hardcoded wallet and pool) and 'pause' (actual miner binary)
Mining Dero coin by joining a Dero mining pool
Exploiting Kubernetes clusters with exposed APIs and anonymous authentication enabled (--anonymous-auth=true)
Impacted Systems: Kubernetes clusters with exposed APIs and anonymous authentication enabled
Attack Vector: Scanning and exploiting Kubernetes API with anonymous access to deploy malicious DaemonSet
Indicators of Compromise: Docker image hosted on Docker Hub based on modified CentOS 7 image
Files named 'entrypoint.sh' and 'pause' added to Docker image
DaemonSet named 'proxy-api' deployed in Kubernetes clusters
